item: Climate: GHCN-Daily station parser and consented fetch (A1-6, fixtures only)
key_paths: src/stats/ghcnd.py; src/stats/fetch.py; tests/test_ghcnd_parser.py; configs/external_artifacts.yml; docs/SECURITY.md; src/static/net-hosts.js
summary: Pure parser for NOAA NCEI GHCN-Daily .dly station files (TMAX/TMIN/PRCP/SNOW/SNWD daily values; -9999 and quality-flagged days are gaps, never measurements, each counted with its reason; trace precipitation counted; other elements named in skipped_elements; refusals counted) and the station list, plus fetch_ghcnd_station behind the kill switch with a body bound derived from the file shape, registry entry ghcnd-dly-shape, www.ncei.noaa.gov on the SECURITY.md Climate stations row and the consent popup. Built on hand-made fixtures: the sandbox cannot reach the host, so the layout is documented, not verified live. Not yet shipped: the station-list fetch, store wiring, any button or surface.
